hook.text: A retailer shuts down for a weekend to count every single item in 200 stores. Is there a better way?

buildup.text: Physical inventory counts compare actual stock on shelves to what the system says should be there.

discovery.text: Discrepancies reveal theft, damage, miscounts, and system errors that erode accuracy over time.

twist.text: Full counts are disruptive and expensive. Cycle counting—counting a portion regularly—is the modern approach.

climax.text: Companies with cycle counting programs maintain 95%+ accuracy without ever shutting down operations.

punchline.text: Count often, count small. Accuracy beats a big annual event.

quiz.question: What is cycle counting?
options: Counting a portion of inventory on a regular schedule
